content.short: CardanoTales is a CNFT collection and a CNFT-hybrid game project. Deep dive in the Dark BlockCave Maze.
content.description:
CardanoTales is a CNFT collection and a CNFT-hybrid game project. The goal is to address the lack of proper games with a successful CNFT gamification.

CardanoTales is a project of collectible CNFTs with gamified utility. CNFTs are implemented in the game engine and holders can play our games with token-access.

Our CNFTs are: Characters, which allow for in-game login and everlasting-time access to the game; Weapons which are items with different rarity and allow in-game stats boosts (and some of them allow for secrets unlock). We distribute the two together, so that any supporter can be involved in both collection mania as well as game playability.

Characters exists on 10k CNFTs (400 of them already holded as Promotional content by early Community supporters). Weapons are paired 1:1 with characters, 10k CNFTs (among them, 400 promo) too. We distribute the couple of character+weapon together for a full minimum playable pack.

No. We rejected specifically all private offers (we received up to 400k$ of proposals): we want to build up a nice community of sincere collectors and happy players. Unfortunately, private deals do cut out the community fun, the fairness of release and the number of community members.

At this stage, the project is in its early phases. The final engine infrastructure and regulamentory set, in case of a successful funding phase, would allow a safe and fun play to earn game. Check full Guidebook for further details on our website.
